## Selected Work / Case Studies
1. **From production waste to a market-ready product line** *(Circular economy · Internal RAG · China / Russia)*
   - Led the transformation of production waste into a commercial product line inside a circular-economy framework — building an internal RAG model for employees to query production data and know-how when designing and creating new products.
2. **Luxury air-quality product, premium repositioning** *(Smart IoT · Repositioning · Italy / Switzerland)*
   - Coordinated a redesign and premium repositioning pairing the device with a companion mobile app for remote control and smart sanitization functions driven by incoming environmental parameters — attracting early-stage business-angel interest.
3. **AI-powered hospitality & smart noise-cancelling beds** *(AI innovation · Smart hardware · France)*
   - Coordinated the end-to-end delivery of an AI-enhanced hospitality solution featuring smart beds engineered to actively cancel external noise through cutting-edge acoustic devices — improving guest comfort, privacy and sleep quality.

## Services Catalog (EN & RU)
All prices below are starting base prices; every engagement is tailored individually to the specific case.

### 1. Private Client / Частный клиент
- **Critical Decision Review (Экспертиза критического решения)** — Up to 5 business days · Starting from €750
  - Includes: 90-min discovery session, review of situation/materials, risk & constraint assessment, alternative scenarios, executive summary, online discussion.
- **Project Go / No-Go (Решение Go / No-Go по проекту)** — Up to 7 business days · Starting from €950
  - Includes: 90-min discovery session, project/concept review, resource/timeline/constraint assessment, key risks & assumptions, executive summary, online discussion.
- **Operational Efficiency Scan (Аудит операционной эффективности)**
  - **Standard:** Up to 10 business days · Starting from €950 (up to 3 stakeholder interviews, process review, executive summary).
  - **Growth:** Up to 20 business days · Starting from €1,900 (up to 10 interviews, 3 core processes, bottleneck/risk analysis, AI & automation assessment, implementation roadmap).

### 2. Investor / Инвестор
- **Deal Risk Screening (Скрининг рисков сделки)** — Up to 5 business days · Starting from €950
  - Independent evaluation before committing capital: business model, team & roles, operational risk evaluation, risk summary & recommendations.
- **Execution Risk Review (Оценка рисков исполнения)** — Up to 7 business days · Starting from €1,500
  - Assessment of startup execution readiness: founder interviews, roadmap review, execution process, team & resource allocation, execution risk report.
- **Post-Investment 100-Day Plan (План первых 100 дней после инвестиции)** — Up to 10 business days · Starting from €2,500
  - Post-investment alignment: operational & org review, priority/risk analysis, 30/60/100-day roadmap, KPI & governance recommendations.

### 3. Startup / Стартап
- **Founder & Team Execution Review (Оценка исполнения у основателя и команды)** — Up to 7 business days · Starting from €1,500
  - Leadership, communication, role alignment, accountability & execution risk assessment.
- **Delivery & Execution Leadership (Лидерство в поставке и исполнении)** — Monthly (min 1 month) · Starting from €2,000/month
  - Hands-on weekly coordination, delivery tracking, blocker removal, stakeholder communication, monthly progress review.
- **Startup Operations Setup (Настройка операционных процессов стартапа)** — Up to 10 business days · Starting from €2,500
  - Process & communication architecture, role & responsibility mapping, Startup Operations Report, Growth Roadmap.
